description: CreateDatabase(path, dbLangGeneral, dbVersion120). XI of round 1 with its rows, then UPDATE XI SET G = 1 WHERE ID = 2 (the second-stored row joins the G = 1 run after it). Dynaset and snapshot of SELECT ID, s FROM XI WHERE G = 1; table-type recordsets on XI with Index IX_XI_G and IX_XI_N, all rows read. Asks whether an index walk's ties come in storage (locator) order or in the order the entries were made.
